sentence: If I have seen further it is by standing on the shoulders of giants.

source.author: Isaac Newton
source.detail: 1675-02-05（儒略历；公历常作 1676）致 Robert Hooke 的信；原句为 If I have seen further it is by standing on the shoulders of Giants.

translation: 如果说我看得更远，那是因为我站在巨人的肩膀上。
grammar: 整句是 If 条件从句 + 主句：If I have seen further（条件）+ it is by standing...（主句）。这里 If 不是「假如会发生」，而是「如果说、即便承认……」的缓和语气。
主句用 it is by + doing：by standing 是方式状语，说明「靠什么方式」看得更远；standing on the shoulders of giants 是动名词短语。
have seen 是现在完成时，强调「已经看到／看得更远」这一结果，而不是单纯叙述过去某一刻。

vocab.meaning: 更远；更进一步（句中修饰 seen，表示看得更远）
vocab.collocation: see further; go further; take it further
vocab.example: Reading the reference manual helped me see further into the interrupt path.

vocab.meaning: 站在……之上；比喻建立在……的基础上
vocab.collocation: stand on the shoulders of; stand on one's own feet
vocab.example: Every driver we write stands on datasheets and errata written by others.

vocab.meaning: 肩膀；句中用复数 shoulders，构成固定比喻
vocab.collocation: on someone's shoulders; shoulder to shoulder; a chip on one's shoulder
vocab.example: The responsibility for that silicon bring-up is on our shoulders.

vocab.meaning: 巨人；巨擘（喻指前辈大师）
vocab.collocation: a giant in the field; standing on the shoulders of giants
vocab.example: Knuth is a giant in algorithms; his books still guide my code reviews.

note: 做嵌入式也一样：寄存器手册、前人驱动、开源社区，都是你的「巨人肩膀」。今天试着口头说一句：If I have ______ further, it is by ______.
